content.overview: Section 10 CPC stays the trial of a later suit when the matter in issue is also directly and substantially in issue in a previously instituted pending suit between the same parties in a competent Indian court.
content.study: Section 10 is a stay rule, not a bar. The former suit must still be pending. Section 11 is the bar after a final decision. Do not plead them as substitutes. The later court does not lose jurisdiction; it must not proceed with the trial while the former suit is pending.

sections.heading: Contrast with Section 11
sections.body: Pending former suit → Section 10 stay. Former suit heard and finally decided → Section 11 bar.
